prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Work Sans; condensed heading with open sans text. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 16px, heading 36px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
